WhatIsPWA.title: What is PWA?
WhatIsPWA.subtitle: Progressive Web App is the Next Generation of App Distribution
WhatIsPWA.desc: It's not just a website, it's a super app that can be "installed" on the user's desktop. It combines the flexibility of the Web with the immersive experience of a Native App, completely freeing you from app store restrictions.
WhatIsPWA.feature1_desc: No redirection to Google Play. Install directly from the browser, shortening the conversion path by 50%.
WhatIsPWA.feature2_desc: Full-screen execution, home screen icon, and standalone launch. Feels exactly like a native app.
WhatIsPWA.feature3_desc: Based on browser technology, there is no risk of certificate revocation, ensuring asset security.

Features.cloaking_desc: Custom template push notifications from the dashboard. Reach installed users for free.
Features.cloaking_detail_desc: Build your private traffic pool and reach users anytime via Web Push without any SMS or channel fees. Boost retention rates by over 50%.
Features.attribution_desc: Full support for AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook, and more.
Features.attribution_detail_desc: Connect ad platforms with landing page data to solve PWA attribution gaps. Track every click, install, and registration in real-time.
Features.landing_desc: Designed for ad approval. Blocks reviewers accurately to significantly boost approval rates.
Features.landing_detail_desc: We maintain a massive blacklist of reviewer IPs combined with AI behavior analysis to accurately identify Google/Facebook crawlers and manual reviewers.
Features.commission_desc: Includes Web-to-APK (W2A) capability. An extra distribution channel, extra security.
Features.commission_detail_desc: Besides PWA, we offer Web-to-App encapsulation to generate standard APKs. Perfect for Google Play listing or third-party channel distribution.
Features.pixel_desc: Built-in store-like templates that boost CTR by 300%.
Features.pixel_detail_desc: Deeply restores the Google Play Store interface, leveraging user trust to significantly reduce download hesitation. Auto-adapts language and device.
Features.price_desc: As low as $0.01/install. No markup, maximize your ROI.
Features.price_detail_desc: Our optimized architecture significantly reduces server costs, passing the savings directly to you. We aim to be the industry's price-performance leader.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about PWA encapsulation & attribution
FAQ.q1: Do I need to provide source code for PWA?
FAQ.a1: No. You only need to provide your H5 website URL and related Logo assets. We handle the encapsulation without touching your code.
FAQ.q2: Will PWA apps be banned by Google Play?
FAQ.a2: Absolutely not. PWAs run on browser technology and do not rely on app store distribution, so there is zero risk of bans, takedowns, or account association.
FAQ.q3: Which third-party platforms does the attribution system support?
FAQ.a3: We are fully compatible with mainstream ad & attribution platforms including AppsFlyer, Adjust, Facebook Pixel, and Google Ads, supporting full-link data postback.
FAQ.q4: How long does it take to convert PWA to APK?
FAQ.a4: Our automated process typically generates a standard APK installation package within 10 minutes, supporting custom signatures and package names.
FAQ.a5: PWA plan: $0.01 per install. W2A plan: $0.01 per download. Volume discounts are available for large clients. Please contact us for details.
FAQ.a6: Certainly. Please contact our business team to get free test credits and experience the full process yourself.
FAQ.a7: We only support USDT top-ups. This ensures maximum payment privacy and fund security for both parties, avoiding risks associated with traditional fiat payments.
FAQ.a8: Yes. For clients with high data security requirements, we offer private deployment upon payment of a deposit. You will need to provide server resources and domain access, and we will handle the deployment and delivery.
